decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-bd329a64ec5d], is a one-line highlight saying the Image Automation APIs are now generally available. It does not say whether anything works differently, so the proposed behavior-change ('still works, but differently') is not supported. It also does not show whether there is no effect ('none') or a hidden deprecation, migration or removal of an earlier API version. To decide the consequence, we need the upgrade guide, CRD or served-version diffs, or release-note text saying whether earlier versions (for example v1beta2) are still served, deprecated or removed, and whether existing objects need migrating.
